name: Event — Banner
summary: Big title over a flat colour field with optional cut-out artwork. The loudest archetype — use it to announce, not to invite.

palette.note: Reads --flyer-field / --flyer-field-ink, not the gradient. palette.js clamps the field dark enough that white type clears AA.

slots.name: eyebrow
slots.label: Intro line
slots.help: One or two sentences of context above the title. Leave empty and the line is removed.

slots.name: title
slots.label: Event title
slots.help: Set in caps by the template — type it normally.

slots.name: art
slots.label: Artwork
slots.help: Transparent PNG (an icon or illustration). Absorbs the leftover vertical space, so it is what keeps a short flyer balanced.

slots.name: details
slots.label: When / how to join
slots.help: Set in spaced caps. Three short lines read better than one long one.

slots.name: cta
slots.label: Call to action (phone number)
slots.help: Ask which number to use — the events/RSVP line is not the food-order line. Never infer one from past flyers.
